summary: Standalone Windows service that continuously captures microphone audio, segments speech with Silero VAD, transcribes with CPU faster-whisper, diarizes with pyannote community-1, and exports schema-versioned JSON/Markdown for future Agent OS ingestion. Identifies speakers against enrolled voice profiles and writes per-person logs.
current_priorities: Triage the unassigned speaker queue with the user (assign-speakers skill).
Observe a long-duration soak run and launch at Windows sign-in.
Verify restart during live speech recovers cleanly.
Optional: add a global pause/resume hotkey.
Design Agent OS ingestion of ingestion/ready exports.
constraints: Python 3.11 venv; pyannote.audio installed with CPU-only torch.
pyannote path decoding needs FFmpeg (torchcodec); diarize() passes in-memory waveforms instead.
Hugging Face token lives only in ~/.cache/huggingface/token, never in the repo.
